dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with a smooth spline curvature from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse shape classification based on the angle between leading and trailing margins.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate angular steepness of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.1 times the vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, moderate convexity of the melon region with a consistent arc radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Elongated and slender beak with a high length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow concave angle visible at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Numerous bright, bioluminescent-like light patches distributed across the lateral flank and anterior head region.
